# pve_ceph_osd (Resource)

One Ceph OSD created on a disk (optionally encrypted, with dedicated db/wal devices); osdid is assigned from the creation task.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ceph_osd" "example" {
dev = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dev` (String) Block device name.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `cleanup` (Boolean) If set, also destroy the underlying logical volumes via 'ceph-volume lvm zap --destroy', remove the volume group's physical volume with pvremove, and wipe any journal/block.db/block.wal partitions left over from filestore OSDs. Without this flag the LVs and partitions are left intact for inspection. (default: 0)
- `crush_device_class` (String) Set the device class of the OSD in crush.
- `db_dev` (String) Block device name for block.db.
- `db_dev_size` (Number) Size in GiB for block.db.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Enables encryption of the OSD. (default: 0)
- `osdid` (Number) OSD ID
- `osds_per_device` (Number) OSD services per physical device. Only useful for fast NVMe devices to utilize their performance better. Mutually exclusive with 'db_dev' and 'wal_dev'.
- `wal_dev` (String) Block device name for block.wal.
- `wal_dev_size` (Number) Size in GiB for block.wal.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/osdid (also the `terraform import` format).
